title: Why Do Dogs Hate Bath Time So Much?
description:
It's not drama. To your dog, this is genuinely terrifying.

script: Your dog isn't being dramatic, bath time is genuinely stressful for them, and a few real reasons stack up all at once. A dog's nose is up to forty times more sensitive than yours, so shampoo, chemicals, and strong scents that seem mild to you can feel completely overwhelming to them. Then there's the loss of control, they can't easily escape, they're standing on a slippery surface that messes with their balance, and water temperature and pressure are entirely out of their hands. On top of that, a wet coat feels heavy and strange against their skin, throwing off senses they usually rely on to read the world around them. None of this means your dog is broken, it just means their body is reacting to a genuinely uncomfortable situation the same way any animal would.
